description: Search international treaties and agreements binding Switzerland (the international part of the Classified Compilation, SR numbers starting '0.': bilateral agreements with the EU, double-taxation agreements, conventions, UN/Council of Europe treaties) by title keyword and/or SR area. Returns SR number, title, short title, entry-into-force date, in-force status and the Fedlex link. Titles are language-specific: {query:'Doppelbesteuerung'} (de), {query:'double imposition', language:'fr'}, {query:'Freizügigkeit'}, {sr_prefix:'0.142.11'} (EU free movement area).

query.description: Title keyword in the chosen language, e.g. 'Doppelbesteuerung', 'Deutschland', 'Menschenrechte'

sr_prefix.description: Restrict to an SR area of international law, e.g. '0.1' (international law), '0.672' (double taxation)

name: search_international_treaties
title: Search international treaties
